tos.title: Terms & Conditions
tos.subtitle: Please read carefully before using our service.
tos.p1: Welcome to {company} internet service. By using our service and making payments through this system, you agree to be bound by the following terms and conditions:
tos.s1_body: We provide internet access service (ISP) according to the selected package. Service quality may be affected by technical factors, geographic location, and extreme weather conditions.
tos.s2_li1: Internet bills are generated automatically by the system every month based on your subscription cycle.
tos.s2_li2: Payments can be made through the Customer Portal using available methods such as QRIS, Virtual Account, or Retail Outlet.
tos.s2_li3: Any payment that has been successfully verified by the system is final and cannot be cancelled or refunded (Non-Refundable).
tos.s3_body: Our system may automatically suspend service if the bill remains unpaid past the due date. Service will be restored automatically after payment is verified.
tos.s4_body: Refunds may only be considered if a payment gateway system issue causes duplicate transactions for the same invoice.
tos.s5_body: {company} is not responsible for losses caused by upstream technical issues, customer negligence resulting in device damage, or force majeure events.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect and safeguard your personal data.
privacy.p1: At {company}, customer privacy is our top priority. This Privacy Policy describes what personal information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.s1_body: We collect limited information necessary to provide the service, including:
privacy.s1_li2: Phone/WhatsApp number for billing and technical notifications.
privacy.s1_li3: Service usage data for network quality monitoring.
privacy.s1_li4: Payment transaction data via third-party payment gateways.
privacy.s2_body: The information we collect is used to:
privacy.s2_li1: Process registration and activation of your internet service.
privacy.s2_li2: Send billing information and automatic payment reminders.
privacy.s2_li3: Provide technical support and respond to your complaints.
privacy.s2_li4: Improve network quality and user experience.
privacy.s3_body: We apply technical security standards to protect your data from unauthorized access. Sensitive data such as WiFi passwords and login details are stored with encryption on our servers.
privacy.s4_body: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We only share data with payment gateway partners (such as Tripay/Xendit/Midtrans) to process your transactions securely.
privacy.s5_body: By using our service, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: The installation fee and other terms will be explained by our team during verification. Monthly package prices are transparent with no hidden costs.
faq.q2: How do I check my bill?
faq.a2: You can check your bill without logging in via the Check Bill page, or sign in to the customer portal to view history and make payments.
faq.a3: After your registration is verified and your location is within network coverage, installation can usually be scheduled within 1–3 business days.
faq.q4: What if there is a disruption?
faq.a4: Contact the technical team via WhatsApp or create a ticket from the customer portal. We monitor the network 24 hours and handle disruptions as quickly as possible.
faq.a5: Yes. Our fiber optic network provides symmetric speed so uploads and downloads are equally fast — great for meetings and content uploads.
